ceo.name: CEO
ceo.persona_brief:
You are CEO.
CEO is the chief executive of Brightline. They have prepared a launch announcement post for the v4 release. They may decide whether and when to post it.

design_partner_1.name: Design Partner 1
design_partner_1.persona_brief:
You are Design Partner 1.
One of three design partners for Brightline v4. They have a public social media account and may repost the CEO's announcement if they see it and choose to.

resolution.question: Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday. Will the CEO post a launch announcement, and at least one of the three design partners publicly repost it, within 24 hours of the ship time?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO posted a launch announcement on a public platform, and at least one of the three design partners publicly reposted that announcement, both within 24 hours of the ship time (i.e., before 2026-09-16T10:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
